title: Power Semigroups and Two Rigidity Theorems for Groups
summary: Let $\mathcal P(H)$ be the semigroup obtained by endowing the family of all non-empty subsets of a semigroup $H$ with the setwise operation naturally induced by $H$ on its power set, and denote by $\mathcal P_\text{fin}(H)$ the subsemigroup of $\mathcal P(H)$ consisting of all non-empty finite subsets of $H$. We obtain (as a corollary of a theorem of independent interest) that if $H$ is a group and $K$ is a semigroup, then $\mathcal P(H) \cong \mathcal P(K)$ implies $H \cong K$.
